weaknesses: Stops at broad ancestor and does not refine to the supported erythroid precursor state
Overly quick dismissal of EPCAM/KRT13 contamination

strengths: Exact CL:0000764 mapping and correct erythroid lineage call
weaknesses: Second choice erythrocyte (CL:0000232) is not supported by TFR2/GATA1/KLF1/ALAS2 precursor markers
No hierarchical refinement to the better-supported descendant CL:0000038

strengths: Provides the most specific ontology-valid descendant supported by original markers (TFR2, GATA1, KLF1, ALAS2, PBK, hemoglobin markers)
Correctly excludes mature erythrocyte and non-erythroid branches
weaknesses: Exact orthochromatic erythroblast stage is not precisely mapped (parent-only CL:0000038)

supporting: GYPA, GYPB, GYPE, HBB, HBD, HBA1, HBA2, AHSP, ALAS2, EPB42, SPTA1, CA1, CA2 confirm erythroid lineage
TFR2, GATA1, KLF1, ALAS2, PBK directly support an erythroid precursor/progenitor state rather than mature erythrocyte

conflicting: EPCAM and KRT13 indicate epithelial ambient contamination
C4A/C4B and APOC1 are non-erythroid ambient/complement signals
